name: bridgeaac
author: BridgeAAC <support@bridgeaac.org>
description: Free, open-source, offline AAC communication app with client-side file interoperability for .ce and Open Board Format (.obf/.obz) files.

scripts.android:init: vite build && cap add android && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: vite build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: vite build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xtool dev build
scripts.ios:ipa: npm run ios:sync && xtool dev build -c release --ipa
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && xtool dev run
